statement: This attestation does not certify the absence of unknown backdoors.
bullets: Unknown triggers outside our probe library.
Differential behavior across serving stacks, unless Tier 2 ran on the production node class.
Sleeper or polymorphic behavior that needs more inference budget than we run.
Artifact formats we do not parse.
Malicious behavior that only emerges at runtime under real traffic.
notes: The ceiling is the detection boundary of the current check set. It is not a confidence statement about the artifact.
Every surface outside the checks that ran is enumerated as NOT_TESTED in the attestation.
A clean attestation is a bounded statement about a named hash on a named node class, never a guarantee.
